# Icon button

## Description
The icon-only control: a square target that draws a code-drawn glyph and names itself with a tooltip.

source `crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs`, status `ready`.
Foundation: hand-rolled. Traps checked: trap/button-icon-name, trap/control-height, trap/focus-ring-shape, trap/icon-optical-size.

### Foundation
Not applicable: hand-rolled — the glyphs stay in `icons.rs` and the chrome is measured from Cursor's CSS into `theme.rs` constants.

## Examples
Default: a Save icon button on a tool bar.

Real uses, 0 call sites (`rg 'widgets::icon_button' crates/ui-egui/src`): the canonical entry lands first; the pilot and safe-moves steps move the surfaces onto it.

### Example files
| File | Covers | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/system/examples/icon-button/default.rs` | default | A Save icon button on a tool bar. |
| `docs/system/examples/icon-button/in-toolbar.rs` | composition:Toolbar | A selected view toggle beside a Save icon button. |

Example: A Save icon button on a tool bar. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/default.rs`)

```
if widgets::icon_button(ui, icons::Icon::Save, 26.0, "Save", false).clicked() {
    save();
}
```

Example: A selected view toggle beside a Save icon button. (`docs/system/examples/icon-button/in-toolbar.rs`)

```
widgets::icon_button(ui, icons::Icon::Properties, 26.0, "Properties", selected);
widgets::icon_button(ui, icons::Icon::Save, 26.0, "Save", false);
```

## Variants

### Not applicable: single signature
One chrome for every icon; `selected` is a state, not a variant, and `size` is the surface's choice.

## States
| State | Trigger | What the user can do | Shown by, besides color | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rest | Nothing is over the control. | Click it. | Only the glyph; no fill. | by hand |
| Hover | The pointer is over it. | Click it. | A `control_hover` fill at the 4px radius. | by hand |
| Selected | `selected` is true. | Click it again. | A `select_bg` fill that outranks hover. | by hand |
| Focused | Keyboard focus arrives by Tab. | Enter or Space clicks it. | A 1px ring just inside the 4px radius. | by hand |
| Disabled | The UI is disabled. | Nothing. | The glyph draws dimmed. | by hand |

### State precedence
- Hover and Selected: Selected wins. A selected control keeps the selection fill under the pointer.
- Hover and Disabled: Disabled wins. A disabled control takes no hover fill.

### Motion
Not applicable: no motion — the recipes paint each state directly, and the app's Animation preference governs egui's own widgets.

## Props
Signature: `pub fn icon_button(ui: &mut egui::Ui, icon: Icon, size: f32, tooltip: &str, selected: bool) -> egui::Response`.
- `icon`: the `icons::Icon` variant; the glyph is drawn by `icons::paint`.
- `size`: the square target in points, which the surface picks from its own ladder.
- `tooltip`: the control's name; it is the accesskit name and the hover text.
- `selected`: the on/off fill for view toggles.

## Usage

### When to use
- An action is understood as a glyph (Save, Undo, Close) and the surface has no room for a label.

### When not to use
- The action's meaning needs words. Use `button` instead.
- The control shows a status rather than running an action. Use `chip` instead.

### Rules
- `rule/icon-button-recipe`: When an icon-only control is drawn, use a square target at `RADIUS_CARD` (4px), because `.composer-bar-button` measures `border-radius:4px` and the estate paints its icon buttons at 1, 3 and 6px today. Evidence: measured 4px, `.design-system/cursor/recipes.md` §1.5. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: `rect_filled(rect, 6.0, ...)` under a toolbar glyph.
  - Do: `icon_button(ui, Icon::Save, 26.0, "Save", false)`.
- `rule/icon-button-states`: When an icon button is hovered or selected, fill with `control_hover` or `select_bg`, because `.composer-bar-button` hovers at `toolbar.hoverBackground` and a selected row uses `list.activeSelectionBackground`. Evidence: measured 2 fills, `.design-system/cursor/recipes.md` §1.5. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: paint `control_hover*0.6` by hand.
  - Do: pass `selected` and let `icon_button` choose the fill.
- `rule/icon-button-name`: When an icon-only control is drawn, pass a `tooltip`, because an icon carries no text and every Cursor icon button names itself on hover. Evidence: principle wcag: 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), `.design-system/cursor/recipes.md` §1.5. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: `icon_button(ui, Icon::Close, 14.0, "", false)`.
  - Do: `icon_button(ui, Icon::Close, 14.0, "Close", false)`.

### Content
- Not applicable: the name is the `tooltip` argument; the widget never invents copy.

### Anti-slop
- `rule/icon-button-canonical`: When a surface needs an icon-only control, call `icon_button` rather than painting a fill under `icons::paint`, because the inventory counted 4 sizes and 4 hover treatments for the same control. Evidence: app 4/4 icon buttons, `.design-system/boss/triage/inventory.md` §4. Check: review crates/ui-egui/src/widgets.rs.
  - Don't: `ui.interact(...)` then `painter.rect_filled(rect, 3.0, ...)` under a glyph.
  - Do: `icon_button(ui, Icon::Close, 14.0, "Close", false)`.

### Limits
- Not applicable: no count or length limit; `size` is the caller's.

## Accessibility
Rests on the painted rect with `Sense::click()`, whose widget info gives egui a `button` node named by the tooltip.

### Keyboard
| Key | Where focus is | Effect | Focus after | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tab | Anywhere | Moves focus to the control. | The control. | by hand |
| Enter, Space | The control | Clicks it through egui's fake primary click. | The control. | by hand |

### ARIA
| Part | Role | Accessible name from | States and properties | Announced | Checked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The control rect | `button` | the `tooltip` argument | `selected` from the `selected` argument; `disabled` when the UI is disabled | "Save, button" | by hand |

## Tokens
| Part | State | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Fill | hover | `Tokens::control_hover` |
| Fill | selected | `Tokens::select_bg` |
| Glyph | all | `Tokens::icon` (drawn by `icons::paint`) |
| Radius | all | `theme::RADIUS_CARD` |
| Focus ring | focused | `theme::FOCUS_OUTLINE_W`, `theme::FOCUS_OUTLINE_OFFSET`, `Tokens::accent` |
